svg.aria-label: dsh-ghg structure: a twelve-row monthly close ledger (one 2026 month per row, real kWh and real per-line tCO2e); the tCO2e column is kWh times the public factor 0.5703 divided by 1000; a state gate turns calculated lines into verified only when the recalculation diff is at most 1e-9, and a mismatch keeps the line id and raises E_GHG_RECALC_MISMATCH; exports for period 2026-12 are a 3-sheet workpaper, a 4-sheet partial ESRS E1 pack and a Scope-2-only CSV; two boundary rails note local writes and read-only coverage / Scope 3 meters
svg.title: dsh-ghg: twelve-month close ledger, one verify gate, three local exports
svg.text: monthly close ledger · one row per month · local only
